historical_references.reference: Aalaa bint Al-Harith, a prominent female poet during the Umayyad period. She is known for her love poetry, which was often addressed to members of the Umayyad ruling family. Her work was highly regarded by the caliphs and is considered an important contribution to classical Arabic literature.

Al-Alaa Ibn Al-Hadrami, a famous scholar and ascetic from Hadramaut in Yemen. He is known for his contributions to Islamic jurisprudence and his role as a teacher and mentor to many early scholars. He lived during the early Abbasid period and is considered an important figure in the development of Islamic scholarship.
